title: ACCOUNT_HEALTH_CHANGED payload
description: EVENT_SCHEMAS.md §6. Producer: account-service. Consumer: none required (audit/ML only; telegram-bot consumes it only for Admin Dashboard health widgets). Emitted on every status or health_score change, not just status transitions — ML training data needs the score trajectory, not just the band crossings.

reason.description: e.g. PURCHASE_FAILED delta, cooldown elapsed, admin action.
